summary: Clean Harbors filed an 8-K reporting the October 1, 2026 issuance of $600.0 million of 6.250% senior unsecured notes due September 30, 2034, under a Rule 144A/Regulation S indenture with U.S. Bank Trust as trustee and domestic subsidiary guarantees. Proceeds fund the previously announced EnviroServe acquisition (closed October 2, 2026) and repay revolver borrowings used for the ES H acquisition (closed September 18, 2026). Interest pays semi-annually from March 31, 2027. This is ordinary financing activity, not a special situation; watch leverage and integration risk.
